summaries.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：Building upon this premise, this paper critically examines the role and efficacy of self-correction within LLMs, shedding light on its true potential and limitations。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：A contemporary methodology, self-correction, has been proposed as a remedy to these issues。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Nevertheless, concerns persist regarding the accuracy and appropriateness of their generated content）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 36 赞），本工作为突破 **推理与测试时计算** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: ImagenHub: Standardizing the evaluation of conditional image generation models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **ImagenHub** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World）。核心论点主张：This paper proposes ImagenHub, which is a one-stop library to standardize the inference and evaluation of all the conditional image generation models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This paper proposes ImagenHub, which is a one-stop library to standardize the inference and evaluation of all the conditional image generation models。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **76%, 74%, 83%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our human evaluation achieves a high inter-worker agreement of Krippendorff's alpha on 76% models with a value...；(2) we examined the claims from published papers and found 83% of them hold with a few exceptions）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 19 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Large Language Models as Analogical Reasoners
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Large Language Models as Analogical** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)）。核心论点主张：In this work, we introduce a new prompting approach, Analogical Prompting, designed to automatically guide the reasoning process of large language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GSM8K, MATH, BIG-Bench**。实验设计与验证细节：Inspired by analogical reasoning, a cognitive process in which humans draw from relevant past experiences to tackle new problems, our approach...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experimental results show that our approach outperforms 0-shot CoT and manual few-shot CoT in a variety of reasoning tasks, including math problem solving in GSM8K and MATH, code...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 16 赞），本工作为突破 **思维链与树搜索 (CoT & Search)、软件工程与代码智能体 (SWE & Coding)** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: SmartPlay : A Benchmark for LLMs as Intelligent Agents
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **SmartPlay** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We introduce SmartPlay: both a challenging benchmark and a methodology for evaluating LLMs as agents。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated great potential toward intelligent agents and next-gen automation, but there currently lacks a systematic...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We release our benchmark at github.com/LLMsmartplay/SmartPlay）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 13 赞），本工作可作为评估 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
